description: This file defines data structures and validation logic for OAuth 2.0 authorization, including PKCE support, resource validation, and request validation within the Mattermost server.

classes.name: AuthData
classes.description: Represents OAuth authorization data including client ID, user ID, code, expiration, redirect URI, scope, and PKCE parameters.

classes.name: AuthorizeRequest
classes.description: Represents an OAuth authorization request with response type, client ID, redirect URI, scope, state, and PKCE parameters.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the AuthData or AuthorizeRequest for correctness, including PKCE and resource validation.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares AuthData before saving by setting default expiration, creation time, and scope.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Checks if the AuthData has expired based on creation time and expiration duration.

methods.name: validatePKCE
methods.description: Validates PKCE parameters for AuthData or AuthorizeRequest.

methods.name: VerifyPKCE
methods.description: Verifies a code verifier against the stored code challenge using S256.

methods.name: ValidatePKCEForClientType
methods.description: Validates PKCE parameters based on whether the client is public or confidential.

methods.name: ValidateResourceParameter
methods.description: Validates a resource parameter per RFC 8707, ensuring it is a valid absolute URI without fragments.
